description: All training data used in this repository. Nothing here is committed to git - the scripts download these files on first run (see .gitignore). This manifest exists so you can see exactly what the model was fed without running anything.

tiny_shakespeare.why: Small enough to overfit in minutes on a laptop, which makes the loss curve move fast enough to stay interesting.

gutenberg_books.license: public domain in the US (Project Gutenberg License)
preprocessing: Download each book as plain UTF-8 text into books/{id}.txt
Cut everything before the '*** START' marker and after the '*** END' marker to drop the Gutenberg boilerplate
Join all books with a blank line between them into book_corpus.txt
Encode the whole corpus with the GPT-2 BPE tokenizer (tiktoken)

books.title: The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson

pretrained_gpt2_124m.license: MIT (model weights, as published by OpenAI)
pretrained_gpt2_124m.note: These are the original OpenAI weights. This repository does not retrain them - it only proves the from-scratch architecture is correct by loading them into it.
